fences.rule: Unborn witness obliges the answer to bring a discriminating instrument or setting into existence, and which instruments must exist before a difference can leave a trace, and what they must be built not to see, is held there.
fences.case: 'Which account is right?' becoming 'What must first be built so their difference can leave a trace?'

fences.rule: If the question is by what mechanism an announcement moves the quantity it predicts, the poll after the campaign, it is Own footprint there; if the question is what the answer must now accomplish, remaining defensible after its own circulation, it is Forecast with teeth here.
fences.case: 'What will the crowd do?' becoming 'What announced forecast remains defensible after the crowd hears it?'
